response:
关闭开关后，明细字段会被隐藏，但其中的值仍会保留，并且不参与必填校验；只有显示时才校验明细。点击按钮只会生成可编辑的检查草稿，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="补充意见")
toggle = Switch(label="填写明细", bind=$on)
nameField = TextField(label="姓名", bind=$name, required=true, placeholder="请输入姓名")
detailField = TextField(label="明细", bind=$detail, required=true, visible=$on)
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查此补充意见表单；这是可编辑草稿，尚未发送。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
